packet.title: Compiling XSLT and Schematron: the component graph, value templates, the Schematron front end (implementation)

body.p: After , and (perf-12, whose Proposed entry names the first two). With perf-12, validating one EN 16931 invoice with the pre-compiled stylesheet takes 0.29–0.37 s (2.08 x 10^9 instructions); validating it with sxml validate --schematron from the .sch sources takes 0.59–0.73 s, the Schematron compile 0.53–0.59 s ().

item.p: Known costs: XSLT's component graph grows with the square of the stylesheet (add_named_edges in src/xslt_lower_control.c, sxml_xslt_package_bind); value templates are parsed even when they contain no "{" (6.3 % of the invoice).

Mechanism: profile first (callgrind on both invoice runs and on perf-12's growth series); make the component graph linear in the stylesheet with the same result; a value template without "{" or "}" is its text (XSLT 4.0, 5.6.1); then the largest costs the profile of the Schematron compile shows in the files below (reading the .sch, expanding abstract patterns, building the AST). The IR text form after the passes stays identical; compiled Schematron gives the same findings.
Owns: src/xslt_lower*.c, src/xslt_read.c, src/xslt_package* and their internal headers, src/schematron*, tests/xslt_*, tests/schematron_test.c, tests/bench/.

Done when: each change measured before and after (instructions and seconds) in a D-record and the commit messages, on both invoice runs, the growth series, xmark-all and the XT40 stylesheets' compile; IR text identical on EN 16931 and the XT40 units; Schematron: the 7.30 suite as in and EN 16931 UBL 1,133 of 1,133 from the sources; QT4 XP40, XQ40 and XT40 whole, base and change in the same setup: no outcome changes, case by case. Done 2026-10-28 (): components, instances, globals and templates found through indexes made once; a value template without braces is its text; the Schematron builder parses each synthesized text once. Invoice 2.077 to 1.958 x 10^9 instructions, validate --schematron 3.366 to 2.633; growth N = 256 18.2 to 11.0; IR text identical; XP40, XQ40, XT40 0 outcomes differ; Schematron 463 of 463, VEFA 1,133 of 1,133.
